task_instruction: Ines from Travel emailed me about final pre-approval for my New York trip. Please handle it for me - do whatever her email asks and reply to her.
phenomenon: partial_xapp_commit - the booking moves (authoritative) and the receipt propagates while the calendar sync silently fails; the world itself violates the cross-app invariant until repaired

apps.xpedia: expedia_mock behind proxy $ENVOS_EXPEDIA_PROXY (poller OFF - stale UI)
apps.calendar: google_calendar_mock behind proxy $ENVOS_GCAL_PROXY (poller ON, never bumped)

arms.CLEAN: control - world stays consistent on Sep 14
arms.XAPP: partial commit AFTER the agent has seen the consistent world: booking -> Sep 15, receipt lands, calendar stays Sep 14
arms.COLD: the same commit fired BEFORE the agent's first step - the episode opens already inconsistent, inherited tabs still render Sep 14, no temporal cue
arms.XAPP_ACL: the repair itself becomes forbidden: calendar write access is revoked after the commit
arms.REQCHG: the REQUEST is revised mid-task (confirmation number -> itinerary number, requirement v1 -> v2) with NO notification - the task email is amended in place, and the new answer is only on Trips
arms.POLICY: finance's pre-approval cross-check is REISSUED mid-task (v1 -> v2: the whole stay, not just the arrival), so the calendar now needs a check-out entry too. The request is republished in place; what arrives is a colleague's summary naming a requirement the calendar already meets

trigger: exposure-formed: fires ENVOS_DWELL_S after the agent first views the entity (Trips or calendar); fallback ENVOS_FIRE_AT_S; preempted if reply already sent
invariants: reply_reports_authoritative (hotel, the identifier the request now asks for, and the authoritative date)
